data.name: Ina
data.gender_notes: Ina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ina was a goddess of fertility and abundance. In Christianity, Ina is considered a saint and patron of sailors and travelers. Her name derives from the Greek word 'ina,' meaning noble or gracious. The name Ina carries the meaning “Noble, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ina usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and nobility of the divine.
data.etymology: Ina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Gracious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ina total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: אינה
in_hebrew.meaning: אינה היא שם שפירושו עברית איננה או אין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אינה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ופירושו 'איננה' או 'אין'. השם אינה מופיע בתנ'ך, אך הוא קשור לשורש העברי 'אין' שפירושו 'לא' או 'אפס'. השם אינה משמש לעתים קרובות בשם נשים נוצריות, ויש לו משמעות עמוקה הקשורה להעדר או לאפס, אך גם לתקווה ולחדש.

in_greek.name: Ίνα
in_greek.meaning: Η Ίνα σημαίνει αγία ή καθαρή
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Ίνα είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει 'αγία' ή 'καθαρή'. Το όνομα αυτό έχει τις ρίζες του στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και συνδέεται με την έννοια της αγιότητας και της καθαρότητας. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ίνα έχει συσχετιστεί με την έννοια της πνευματικής καθαρότητας και της εγγύτητας με το Θεό.

in_latin.name: Ina

The name has been used across various cultures, symbolizing innocence, simplicity, and devotion to faith.

data.cultural_impact: Ina, also known as Santa Inés or Vestal Ina, is a Hispanic and Filipino name, and is associated with the Spanish influence in the Philippines. The name carries the rich cultural history of the country's past, particularly its Spanish colonization. Santa Inés is known as the patroness of the Filipino diaspora and travels, and is often invoked for safety and protection while at sea or on journeys.

Ina embodies the spiritual journey of seeking a deeper connection with the divine, and going beyond the material world to find meaning, purpose, and fulfillment.
